title: 2026 GCF bus occupancy and coach-factor QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Bus factors are expressed on a passenger-km basis using average occupancy assumptions.
The methodology distinguishes local bus outside London, London bus, average local bus and coach categories.
Local bus occupancy inputs are primarily sourced from DfT bus statistics.
London and non-London local bus factors use different average passenger occupancies.
An average-local-bus factor is separately reported rather than inferred from one city category.
Coach services have a separate factor from local buses.
Coach occupancy information is estimated from data supplied by a major coach operator.
The methodology notes that the coach occupancy information is provided for information and is not used in deriving coach factors.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat contextual occupancy as derivation input.

facts.source_fact: Reported bus totals include CO2, CH4 and N2O components on a CO2e per passenger-km basis.
The bus table is a company-reporting conversion-factor surface, not a parcel measurement surface.
